description: This file defines the interface 'LoanLifecycleStateMachine' which declares methods related to the state transitions of a loan's lifecycle, including methods for transitioning states based on events and determining the appropriate status after transactions.

classes.name: LoanLifecycleStateMachine
classes.description: An interface that specifies methods for managing state transitions of loans in their lifecycle.

methods.name: dryTransition
methods.description: Simulates a state transition based on a given event without modifying the actual loan state; returns the resulting LoanStatus.

methods.name: transition
methods.description: Performs a state transition for the given loan based on an event.

methods.name: determineAndTransition
methods.description: Evaluates the current status of the loan at the end of processing and transitions it to the appropriate status, considering factors like overpayment and outstanding balance.
